context_requirements: Active intrinsic apoptosis signaling with BAX-dependent mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
A death stimulus or stress that engages the mitochondrial apoptosis pathway
Expression of BAX and downstream caspase machinery
falsifiers: A reproducible transcriptional response at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Dose-dependent changes in apoptosis or stress gene expression after 10 micromolar treatment
Evidence that the compound directly regulates transcription rather than only blocking cytochrome c release

evidence.supports: Apoptotic cell death can proceed through mitochondrial engagement and cytochrome c release, providing a context in which blocking cytochrome c release could matter.
